_note: J2 per-candidate sampling and chat_template_kwargs (DESIGN.md amendment C, F3), read by R&D on 2026-10-17 from each maker's card and chat template at the revision named. Every key is a llama-server /v1/chat/completions field at 620d2225 (tools/server/server-task.cpp). Keys the card doesn't name are set to their disabled value, never left at llama-server's defaults (top_k 40, min_p 0.05, common.h). The revision must be the one the GGUF was converted from; if it differs, R&D re-reads the card there.
harness_rules: thinking on for every candidate that has a thinking mode, at the card's recommended effort or the template's default inside the card's recommended range
where the card leaves a range or names no value, the template's default inside that range

open_questions.Q1: R1-Distill's card says to use no system prompt and to put every instruction in the user turn. Aider sends a system prompt. Proposal: for this candidate only, the proxy folds the system message into the first user turn, and records that on every generations.jsonl line. Approved by the maintainer 2026-10-17; DESIGN.md amendment D2, pending Argon.
open_questions.Q2: Qwen3.8's template keeps earlier turns' thinking by default, but the proxy strips reasoning_content from Aider's replies, so the history never carries it. Proposal: for a candidate whose template preserves thinking by default, the proxy re-attaches the logged reasoning_content to the matching earlier assistant turn (matched by content sha256), and records that it did. Approved by the maintainer 2026-10-17; DESIGN.md amendment D2, pending Argon.

candidates.card_section: API Usage: the thinking-mode sampling tip; reasoning_effort; preserve_thinking
candidates.notes: All three kwargs are the template's defaults, pinned explicitly. preserve_thinking only has an effect if the history carries the thinking: see open question Q2.

candidates.card_section: Best practices: thinking mode for precise coding tasks
candidates.notes: The card gives a separate thinking-mode set for precise coding (temperature 0.6, presence 0.0); bug fixing is that. Its SWE-bench footnote used temperature 1.0 in a benchmark scaffold, not as a recommendation. preserve_thinking defaults off in this template and is left off.

candidates.card_section: Recommended settings (temperature and top_p for all tasks); Thinking Modes
candidates.notes: The card names only temperature and top_p, so top_k and min_p are disabled, not left at llama-server's defaults (40, 0.05). Thinking (the default) at full effort, not low_effort.

candidates.card_section: 1. Sampling Parameters; 2. Thinking Mode Configuration; 3. Multi-Turn Conversations
candidates.notes: This template defaults enable_thinking to false; it is set true under the harness rule (thinking on for every candidate). The card says history keeps no thinking, which the proxy's stripping already gives. Gemma's prohibited-use policy was checked (F14): eligible.

candidates.card_section: Best Practices: Sampling Parameters; Reasoning Strength
candidates.notes: The card says high or xhigh for coding and agentic tasks. The template writes 'Reasoning strength: <value>' into the system prompt itself and defaults to high. Pinned at high: the template default, inside the card's range.

candidates.card_section: Model overview: Recommended Sampling; the OpenAI-client examples
candidates.notes: The card's coding-agent note adds force_nonempty_content for tool calls. This template at this revision never reads it, and Aider's diff format uses no tools, so it is not injected. top_k and min_p disabled.

candidates.card_section: Model overview: Recommended Sampling (text); the reasoning-mode example
candidates.notes: NVIDIA's own GGUF: the template that runs is the one embedded in the GGUF. The source repo's template is recorded for comparison, and the preflight checks that the two agree. Full effort (medium_effort false). top_k and min_p disabled.

candidates.card_section: Usage Recommendations 1 and 2, and the forced think opening
candidates.notes: The template already opens every reply with the think tag, as the card asks. The card also says to use no system prompt, and Aider sends one: see open question Q1. top_k and min_p disabled.

candidates.card_section: Model overview: Recommended Sampling (text: temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95); Text and reasoning example
candidates.notes: Used text-only. The template defaults are enable_thinking true and medium_effort false, so reasoning is the full 'on' level; medium_effort is not injected. Vision sampling (temperature 0.6) does not apply. top_k and min_p disabled.

proxy_rules.reattach_thinking: map content sha256 -> list of reasoning (first in, first out); stripped-content fallback; a turn equal to one of Aider's fixed acknowledgements at the pinned version is counted 'synthetic', any other unmatched turn 'mismatch'; reattach_max_turns (null = all) set only if E3's run requires it
proxy_rules.fold_system: leading system messages to the head of the first user turn; later ones to the tail of the preceding user turn; assert none reach the model
proxy_rules.preflight_thinking: non-empty reasoning_content and no <think> or <|channel>thought tag in content, for every thinking candidate
